summary: Official 1.0.0 release of Anything — featuring integrated app management, live release feeds, in-app updating, and high-performance workstation workflows.
newFeatures: Unified app catalog with automatic GitHub releases detection and sync
Real-time update download, background install, and splash screen system
Independent child app update pipeline without full suite reinstall
Modern glassmorphism UI with customized theme palettes and system tray integration
improvements: Ultra-responsive app launching and window state persistence
Instant dynamic version checking and auto-fetching releases
Enhanced security with sandboxed child processes and integrity checks
fixes: Fixed child app release tag parsing and version synchronization
Resolved duplicate update prompt states across workstation apps
Optimized resource caching and memory footprint

emailNotification.subject: 🎉 Anything v1.0.0 is Live: Master Workstation Suite!
